Veigar

the Tiny Master of Evil
Mid laneBot lane

Veigar bot replaces the marksman with a mage who scales forever. With Teleport and First Strike, he farms safely, stacks AP with Baleful Strike and comes online as a one-shot threat. His support handles lane fights while Veigar cages enemies for his support to follow up.

When to pick Veigar

✗ Better as a counter-pick

He loses to marksmen with long range or spell shields, so pick him after you see the enemy bot lane.

Pick into

  • Short-range marksmen who dash in, like Lucian
  • Immobile marksmen without escapes, like Caitlyn or Ezreal
  • Lanes where your support has crowd control
  • Long games where your AP keeps growing

Avoid into

  • Marksmen with spell shields, like Sivir
  • Stealthy kiters like Twitch
  • Long-range poke lanes that keep you from farming
  • Teams that end fast before you scale

Great teammates

SennaRoot plus range sets up your combo.
LeonaEngage locks enemies in place for your cage.
AlistarKnock-up sets up your full combo.

Your team needs: A support with crowd control, and some frontline to protect you while you scale.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Event Horizon cages both enemies in a 2v2 lane
  • Infinite scaling: your AP keeps growing every time you hit champions or kill minions with Q
  • Teleport lets you join fights across the map
  • High win rate in bot this patch

Weaknesses

  • Weak early against marksmen who poke with autos
  • No dash, so marksmen with range kite you
  • Needs time to stack AP, so early fights are risky
  • Hard to farm under tower against fast-pushing lanes

Power spikes

  • Level 6: Primordial Burst finishes low-health enemies
  • First item (Luden's Echo): extra burst and mana
  • Second item (Stormsurge): your combo kills squishy targets
  • Third item (Rabadon's Deathcap): huge AP boost, often with your stacks you one-shot carries
  • Bot quest done: extra gold and your boots move to the quest slot

Top tips

  • Last-hit with Q to stack AP: every minion counts
  • Let your support start fights, then follow with your spells
  • Use Teleport to join fights across the map
  • Save Primordial Burst for a low-health target
  • Cage enemies when they dive you or your support
  • Build Zhonya's Hourglass against assassins and divers
